title: Convert from `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` to `go.yaml.in/yaml/v4`
body: We now use 3 versions of this YAML library (v2, v3, v4). Our usage of v2 is in a dependency and not easily fixed, but we should be able to convert our usage of v3 to v4. Some APIs we were using in v3 were deprecated and removed in v4, so this may be a bit challenging.
